speaker: Doctor
text: That is a crucial piece of information; Cushing's syndrome can indeed cause pulmonary hypertension and interstitial lung changes. speaker: Patient

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Idiopathic Pulmonary Fibrosis (IPF) with incidental adrenal hyperplasia (likely benign). The patient's normal autoimmune panel, lack of Cushingoid features (no bruising/weight gain), and gradual worsening of dyspnea point to IPF rather than fibrosis caused by Cushing's syndrome. The adrenal finding appears incidental.
